summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a routine Form 6-K notification of equity issuance under its existing block listing, covering 30 September to 29 October 2026. The company issued 537 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each under the HSBC International Employee Share Purchase Plan, leaving a balance of 1,599,274 unallotted shares in that plan. Issued share capital stood at 17,135,024,028 ordinary shares as of 29 October 2026; new shares rank pari passu. No special-situation event, terms, board recommendation, or advisor is involved; the filing is an ordinary employee-share-plan administrative disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
